title: Division by zero risk in setDepletionDuration()
description: The setDepletionDuration() function does not validate that the new duration is non-zero. If set to zero, subsequent reward calculations that divide by the depletion duration will revert with a division by zero error, effectively bricking the reward distribution mechanism until the admin corrects the value.
impact: Temporary denial of service if admin accidentally sets duration to zero. Reward distribution would be blocked until the parameter is corrected. Requires admin error to trigger.
attackPath: Reward calculations attempt division by zero
Protocol is bricked until admin fixes the value
recommendation: Add a require statement to validate that the new depletion duration is greater than zero: `require(newDuration > 0, "Duration must be non-zero")`.
